name: Silent Spirits
detailed_description:
🕵️‍♂️ About This Game – Silent Spirits

Step into the smoky shadows of 1920s America, where every bottle is a secret and every sale is a risk.
Silent Spirits is a first-person simulation game set during the Prohibition era. As the owner of a once-legal bar, you're forced underground when the government bans alcohol. Now, your survival depends on secrecy, strategy, and spirits.

🍾 Run Your Own Speakeasy

Manage your hidden bar, serve demanding customers, and make sure the booze never runs dry. Choose when to produce, when to sell, and when to hide.

⚗️ Craft Illicit Liquor

Gather materials and use specialized equipment to produce classic Prohibition-era drinks—beer, wine, whiskey, vodka, and more. New recipes unlock as the years pass, each requiring precision and care.

🕰️ Balance Your Days and Nights

Each in-game day is split into phases:

  • Daytime: Produce and prepare

  • Evening: Serve customers at your bar

  • Midnight: Watch for cops on patrol

  • Early Morning: Fulfill mafia deliveries—if you dare

👮 Stay One Step Ahead of the Law

Police patrols become more aggressive as Prohibition tightens. Get caught smuggling, and you’ll lose cash and materials—or worse.

🕴️ Work With the Mob

The mafia keeps your business alive—but they expect results. Meet their quotas each year, and they might reward you with rare recipes. Fail, and you won’t see the next year.

📰 15 Years of History

From 1919 to 1933, survive the escalating tension of a nation under ban. Each year brings new mechanics, increased difficulty, and a newspaper headline chronicling your journey through the underground.

🎺 Atmosphere is Everything

Immerse yourself in the rich, stylized world of Silent Spirits—complete with vintage jazz music, dimly-lit bars, smoky backrooms, and a constant sense of danger.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game features historical themes set during the 1920s Prohibition era in the United States. It includes references to alcohol production and distribution, as well as interactions with law enforcement and organized groups in a fictionalized setting.

No explicit violence or sexual content is present. All content is presented in a stylized, atmospheric, and narrative-driven manner inspired by the era.
